name: PSCD-GS
aliases: Role-Aware Perception-Structure Collaborative Densification for 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A role-aware perception–structure collaborative densification framework for 3DGS that integrates image-space perceptual responses with multi-view structural evidence to guide Gaussian densification.
summary: PSCD-GS is a densification strategy for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses role-aware perception-structure collaboration to guide primitive selection and splitting.
